problem_statement: The message clone operation should let a caller choose how the reserved header is configured on the clone. Specifically, cloning a message must be able to either keep the same reserved-header size as the original or produce a clone with no reserved header. The public clone API and the internal clones that previously assumed a fixed reserved-header behavior must support this, so that a clone with no reserved header truly reports a reserved size of zero rather than inheriting the original's.
